apps.subtitle: The Most Awesome TikTok Tweak for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
RXTikTok 1.5.4 RELEASE:

ADDED:
- Anonymous Activity Status (read the alert prior to reporting an issue!)
- Bypass Follow Count Search Bar Limit of 5k
- English Strings Completely Rewritten
- Remove Shop Videos
- Play in Native Player
- Download DM Media
- Disable Double-Tap on Feed
- Disable Double-Tap on Stories
- Toggle to Show “Auto-Scroll” in Unsupported Regions
- Account Region Info in “Video Info”
- Remove “Find Similar” Button when Pausing a Video
- Remove “Tako AI” Button above Users’ Profile Pictures
- Story Like Confirmation
FIXED:
- “Always Open in Safari” Re-Added
- Importing Settings
- Follow Confirmation in Profiles
- Tab Bar Labels Toggle
- Confirmations for Actions
- Channel Link in Credits
CHANGED:
- Full Country Names shown on “Video Info”
- More JB Detection Changes
REMOVED:
- Comment Redesign 
- Comment Mass Reply Unfold
